stem.text: Ethanal, $\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}$, is used to make product R in a three-stage synthesis.

stem.latex: \text{CH}_3\text{CHO} \xrightarrow[\text{/NaCN}]{\text{HCN}} \text{product P} \xrightarrow{\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4\text{(aq), reflux}} \text{product Q} \xrightarrow{\text{conc. H}_2\text{SO}_4\text{ (a few drops)}} \text{product R}

stem.text: Two molecules of Q react to give one molecule of R plus two molecules of water.
R has two ester functional groups in each molecule. R does not react with sodium.
What is the empirical formula of R?
